app.title: Phyllotaxis: An audio-reactive LED display
app.author: evakhoury
app.description: A Raspberry Pi / ESP32 based LED strip controller that visualizes audio input in real‑time using a phyllotaxis pattern algorithm.
similar_tools: Raspberry Pi LED Matrix Audio Visualizer
proposed_tests: Clone the repo and build the firmware for the target board using `make`.
Connect the board to a 5V LED strip and run the demo to verify the LED pattern updates with a test audio file.
Run the provided unit tests for the phyllotaxis algorithm and check coverage.
Measure the CPU usage and power draw during a 30‑second audio playback.
Validate the WebSocket endpoint (if included) by sending a JSON payload and observing the LED response.
